h:
这是一个简单的工作流程，我用来生成不同的字符角度和表情，基于 ComfyUI 自定义节点提供的示例工作流程：ComfyUI-Simple-Prompt-Batcher (https://github.com/ai-joe-git/ComfyUI-Simple-Prompt-Batcher).

ComfyUI-Simple-Prompt-Batcher 允许您在一次运行中输入多个提示（每行一个）。关键在于写出精确的提示以达到你想要的结果。我已将我的提示参考作为注释包含在工作流程中，并且可以随意尝试不同的提示，以找到最适合您的提示。

结合 Flux.2 Klein 9B 强大的编辑功能，生成字符表变得异常简单。

o.en:
This is a simple workflow I use to generate different character angles and expressions, based on the example workflow provided by ComfyUI custom node: ComfyUI-Simple-Prompt-Batcher (https://github.com/ai-joe-git/ComfyUI-Simple-Prompt-Batcher).

ComfyUI-Simple-Prompt-Batcher allows you to input multiple prompts (one per line) in a single run. The key lies in writing precise prompts to achieve your desired outcome. I’ve included my prompt references as notes in the workflow, and feel free to experiment with different prompts to find what works best for you.

Combined with the powerful editing features of Flux.2 Klein 9B, generating character sheets becomes incredibly easy.
